description: This file defines the CultureValue class, a custom FluidValue implementation for handling culture information within OrchardCore's Liquid templates. It provides properties and methods to access culture details and supports asynchronous retrieval of supported and default cultures.

classes.name: CultureValue
classes.description: A FluidValue implementation that encapsulates culture information, allowing templates to access culture properties and supported cultures asynchronously.

methods.name: CultureValue
methods.description: Default constructor that uses the current UI culture.

methods.name: CultureValue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CultureValue with a specific CultureInfo.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the string representation of the culture.

methods.name: ToBooleanValue
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the culture object is truthy.

methods.name: WriteToAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes the culture name to a TextWriter.

methods.name: GetValueAsync
methods.description: Retrieves culture-related properties asynchronously based on the property name.

methods.name: GetSupportedCulturesAsync
methods.description: Fetches supported cultures asynchronously via ILocalizationService.

methods.name: GetDefaultCultureAsync
methods.description: Fetches the default culture asynchronously via ILocalizationService.
